en.title: Ordering Coffee

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Hi, what can I get for you today?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: I'll have a medium latte, please.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: To go. And a blueberry muffin.

en.culturalNotes: In the US, 'to go' is used instead of 'takeaway'.

es.title: Pidiendo un café

lines.speaker: Cliente
lines.text: Un café con leche, por favor.

es.culturalNotes: In Spain, it's very common to just say '¿qué le pongo?' when asking for an order.
